title: Experts disagree on runtime/hooks
context:
Chief architect: Both hold at once. Logging is the requirement; never throwing back into the hook is the constraint on how it is implemented. A best-effort append that swallows its own errors satisfies the second while delivering the first.

Target: runtime/hooks
- devops-engineer: A hook that fails to load its compiled half must leave a diagnosable trace on disk rather than exiting 0 in silence.
- devops-engineer: Logging a hook failure must never block the host or throw back into the hook.
